paite: Alal kum kuana kum, akha sawmna, ani sawm ni in hichi ahong hi a, asepaih tengteng toh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong kuan in Jerusalem ahong dou a, om mun ava bawl a; kulh in a-umsuakta hi.
heading: Jerusalem Pukna / (2 Kro 36.13-21; Jer 52.3b-11)

paite: Hichi in kumpipa Zedekiah lal akum sawm-le-khatna tan in khua um in a-om hi.
Akha lina, ani kua ni in khua akial mahmahta a, huai gam mite a ding in tanghou a-om kei hi.
Khopi kulh ahihvang ua, zan in gal dou thei mi tengteng kumpipa huan ning, kulhbaang nih kikal a kulh kongpi ah ataikhe vek ua; Kaldaite'n khua a umsuak uhi; kumpipa Arabah lampi ah apai hi.
Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah apha ua; asepaih tengteng in amah taizaksan vek uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah api ua; atungtang thu angaihtuah uhi.
Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat ua, Zedekiah mitte akhelkhiaksak ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
Huchi in Babulon kumpipa, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar lal akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, ani sagih ni in Jerusalem ah Babulon kumpipa vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan alut hi.
heading: Tempul Hihsiatna / (Jer 52.12-33)

paite: TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a; Jerusalem inn tengteng, inn thupi taktakte ahal hi.
Vengmi pawl heutu kiang a om Kaldai sepaih tengteng in Jerusalem kim a kulhte ahihchim vek uhi.
Khopi sung a nutsiat a om mite, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipia mite leh mipi dang teng vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in sal in api vek hi.
Huai gam a azawng tatate lak a mite vengmi pawl heutu in grepgui kem ding leh lou bawl ding in anusia hi.
TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh atunnate leh dal limlang tuipi Kaldaite'n ahihkekgawp vek ua, adal Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
Belte, vutluahnate, khawnvak puantehnate, keute leh dal tui-um belsuan tengteng, nasepna dia azatte uh ala uhi.
Mei laknate, belkuangte toh, vengmi pawl heutu in dangka-eng abawlte bel adangka-eng ala a, dangkasik a bawlte adangka ala hi.
Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl khuampi nih, tuikuangpi khat leh atunnate leh hiai vanzat tengteng bawlna dal buk theih vual ahi kei hi.

Khuam khat sandan tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, adawn ah dal sunbawk a-om a; huai sunbawk sandan tong thum ahi. Sunbawk kim ah agial tiktek leh theibuhfai atuang a, dal a bawl vek ahi uh. Huchi mah bang in khuampi khat leng agial tiktek hi.
Vengmi pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh azompa siampu Zephaniah leh kongkhak vengmi thum aman hi.
heading: Juda Mite Babulon A Pi Ahi Uh / (Jer 52.24-27)

paite: Galdou thei mite tung a heutu khat toh, kumpipa kiang a om khopi tung a om lai ngate toh, mipite mingelhpa sepaihte heutu laigelhmi toh, khopi sung a om lai gam a mi sawmguk toh khopi sung a pan aman hi.
Vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in amau api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah apaipih hi.
Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam, Riblah ah amau ana that hi. Huchi in Judah, agamsung a pan sal a pikhiak in a-omta hi.
Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah gam a anutsiat teng tung ah Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah ukpa ding in abawl hi.
heading: Judah Ukpipa Gedaliah / (Jer 40.7-9; 41.1-3)

paite: Huchi in sepaih pawl heutu tengteng leh aheute'n Babulon kumpipa'n Gedaliah ukpa in abawl chih azak un Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahoh ua, huaite bel Nathaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapa Johanan, Netophah mi Tanhumeth tapa Seraiah, Mak mi tapa Jaazaniah leh aheute ahi uhi.
Gedaliah huai mite leh aheute uh kiang ah akichiam a, akiang uah, "Kaldaite sikha a om lau kei un. Hiai gam ah teng unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem un, huchi in nou a ding in ahoih ding," achi hi.

Himahleh akha sagihna ah hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa suan Elishama tapa, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel mi sawmkhat toh ahong kuan a, Mizpah a Juda mi leh Kaldai mi akiang a om teng leh Gedaliah ahong sual ua, athat vek uhi.
Huchi in mi tengteng aneu leh alian in sepaih heutute toh apawtkhia ua, Kaldaite alauh ziak un Aigupta gam ah apaita uhi.

Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in alal pat tung kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin atanna inn a pan akhahkhia hi.
heading: Suangkul A Pan Jehoiakin Khahkhiak Ahi / (Jer 52.31-34)

paite: Akiang ah hoihtak in thu agen a, Babulon a kumpipa om samte laltutphah tung ah alaltutphah akoihsang tuamse hi.
Atanna inn puansilhte akheng a, adamsung teng in akiang ah an ane gige samta hi.
Huchi in aloh ding, kumpipa'n apiak tatlak lou a-om a, adamsung teng in, niteng a azat ding abawlsak gige hi.
